reading: Ordered rules. For a document and a field, the first rule that applies wins; exceptions go on top. A rule that applies but cannot read its value abstains ([TO CONFIRM]); it never falls through to a looser rule. When a classification is wrong, fix the rule here and rebuild: never the output.

parameters.amount_token_note: The token is the whole run of digits and of every character that can group digits (dot, comma, apostrophes and their look-alikes, any space) when it stands between two digits. It is never cut at a separator the reader does not know: before v2.0.1 it stopped at an apostrophe and EUR 150'000.00 was read as 150.00 (finding T16, blind run of 2026-09-30, eval/history.json run 5). Which groupings are read is decided by dossier/lib/numbers.py; any other abstains.
parameters.amount_guards_note: An amount whose reading is not certain is left unread ([TO CONFIRM]), never shown as fact: when the figure goes on past the token (two separators, a character attached to it), when a magnitude word stands next to it (EUR 150 thousand, Mio. EUR 150), and for every amount of a document that states a scale (in thousands of EUR, TEUR, EUR '000). Added with v2.0.1 (finding T16).
parameters.heading_note_2_0_4: Since v2.0.4 (D30b, forms found by the blind run of v2.0.3, eval/history.json run 11) a heading is read by class in two forms: with its terminal '.' or ':' (holders_heading, directors_heading), and without it (holders_heading_bare, directors_heading_bare) only when the heading is the whole line and the next line is an item of the same list ('4. Shareholders', 'Article 4. Stockholders', 'iv. Quotaholdings', '§ 4 Holders' followed by a holder line). The directors' heading takes the same clause numbers as the holders' heading ('(5) Directors:', '§ 5 Directors', 'Article 5. Directors', 'v. Directors'). Two directors' headings in one document abstain, as two holders' headings do. Still not a heading: a 'current' qualifier in free words ('Shareholders once the transfer has taken effect:') - the table stays unread and the entity blocked (known limit).
parameters.holders_heading_note_2_0_3: Since v2.0.3 (D30, forms found by the blind run of v2.0.2, eval/history.json run 9) the grammar also reads, by class: the qualifier that says 'current' in parentheses or after a comma ('Holders (as at the document date):', 'Holders, now:'); the qualifier that says the holders are the registered ones at the document date ('of record', 'on record', 'registered', 'entered in the register (of members)'), alone or before a 'current' qualifier; the clause numbers '4.', '4)', '4.1.', '(4)', 'IV.', 'Article 4 -'; the nouns 'shareholdings', 'shareholding structure', 'quotaholdings'; the marker of the synthetic world '(synthetic)' at the end. Still not a heading: a qualifier with an explicit date ('Holders at 16 February 2026:'), a qualifier of another time ('before the transfer', 'former'), 'owners', 'beneficial owners', 'ownership structure', 'allocation of the capital', 'directors'.
parameters.holders_heading_note: The heading of a holders' table is a grammar, not a list of phrasings: a holder noun (holders, shareholders, quotaholders, members, partners), optionally numbered, optionally with a qualifier that says the table is current (after the transfer, as at the document date, now), before or after the noun. A qualifier that is not known to mean 'current' (before the transfer, former, as at another date) is not a heading, and the document then abstains on the holders as before. Owners, beneficial owners and directors are not holder nouns. Two headings in one document abstain: which table is current is not ours to choose. Added with v2.0.2 (decision D26 of 2026-09-30: OWN-015 stays 'block'; reworded headings were the first cause of entities blocked wrongly on the stress suite).
parameters.item_grammar_note_2_0_4: Since v2.0.4 (D30b) the separator may also be a run of three or more dots (dot leaders, '- P-014 (Pia Mendaci) .......... 50%'); the share then never starts with a dot. A line 'Total' with a separator and a share (or a number of quotas or shares) is read only as the LAST line of a holders' table (item_total): the rows are the table, and the Total is recorded as stated_total; a Total that differs from the exact sum of the rows makes the table not sum to the whole, and OWN-010 blocks. A share may stand before the holder ('- 60% P-002 (Bruno Simulanti)', EXT-HOLD-010 item_matches_share_first) when it is a per cent with its sign or word, or a fraction n/d (share_token_first); a share in words or a number of quotas before the holder is not read (the table stays unread, OWN-015).
parameters.item_grammar_note: Since v2.0.3 (D30) a holder line is read by class, not by one literal form: an optional list marker (dash, bullet, '1.', '1)', '(1)', 'a)', '(a)', 'i)', '(i)'); the identifier first with its name in parentheses, or the name first with the identifier in parentheses; a separator (colon, tab, pipe, a dash between spaces, or a space); the share. The share is read by dossier/lib/numbers.py parse_share (per cent with '%', 'per cent', 'percent' or 'pct', a fraction n/d, a whole number of per cent in words, a simple fraction in words); a number of quotas or shares is read only when the same document states the total number once (parameter count_total), and every holder of the table is then counted. Anything else on the line - a second identifier in the name, nested parentheses, a share in another form, a table that mixes counts and shares - leaves the whole table unread, as before.
parameters.count_total_note: A number of quotas or shares is a share of the entity only through the total. The total is read from the same document, and only when these patterns find one value (the same value found twice is one value); no total, or two different totals, and the counts are not read: the table is [TO CONFIRM] and OWN-015 blocks. The counts of a table are divided by that total and summed like any other share, so counts that do not add up to the total make a table that does not sum (OWN-010). Added with v2.0.3 (D30).

holders_evidence.reading: A document whose type is not recognised is not read for facts (DISC-005 keeps every field it may change [TO CONFIRM]). Its body is still checked for holders' tables, so that it does not block the entity for nothing (OWN-015): every table under a holders' heading (parameter holders_heading) is read with the item grammar of EXT-HOLD-010 and summed; every other body line goes through these rules, first match wins, after the phrases of neutral_phrases are removed. One line decided as evidence, one table not read whole, two tables, or a header that cannot be read, and the document stays 'not read': it blocks the entity as before. The rules err on the side of evidence: a line wrongly taken as evidence costs coverage, a line wrongly passed could hide a table that does not sum. Added with v2.0.2 (decision D26 of 2026-09-30).

unread_fields.reading: Which fields a document whose type is not recognised may change (DISC-005, parameter unread_document_scope of rules/discrepancy.json). Checked only when the type is the header's only problem; a document with any other header problem may change every field. Every body line outside a holders' table read whole goes through these rules. The rules marked 'topic' are all tried: a line may speak of several fields, and every field it may speak of is kept. Only when no topic rule applies are the others tried, in order, first match wins: a figure, an identifier, an amount or a label that no topic explains makes the document one that may change every field; a holders' heading, a title marked as invented and a closing sentence saying the document states nothing more state no field; any other line may change every field (default FEV-999). The shareholders are decided by the holders' check (holders_evidence): a table read whole may change them, 'no_table' does not. The rules err on the side of evidence: a word wrongly taken as a topic costs coverage (the field stays [TO CONFIRM]), a line wrongly passed could let a fact be shown that the unread document contradicts. Added with v2.0.3 (D30: on the perturbed corpus of seed 20261013 a document of unrecognised type left every field of its entity [TO CONFIRM], including fields it does not speak of).
